components.name: HeroSection
components.doc: A landing page hero in three designs on a solid page with a faint dot grid: a live product window with floating cards, an automation graph that routes sample events, and editorial type over a strip of scrolling words. No gradients.

components.name: HeroSectionBlock
components.doc: Preview: a slim bar to choose the version, and the chosen hero filling the rest of the screen. Switching replays the entrance.

components.name: HeroNav
components.doc: The bar across the top of a hero: brand, section links, and the way in.

components.name: HeroBackdrop
components.doc: The faint grid of solid dots behind a hero. Set `--dots-fade` on it (a mask image) to choose where the grid fades out.

components.name: HeroMark
components.doc: One phrase of a headline under a solid accent marker that draws in from left to right.

components.name: ActionLink
components.doc: A link or button that looks like a ryan-ui button. Links keep native navigation; a button with `doneLabel` confirms in place.

components.name: HeroContent
components.doc: The hero with your own content: announcement, headline, description, actions, an optional install line, and an optional visual beside the copy, on a solid page. Use it when none of the three designed variants fits the product.

components.name: HeroLumen
components.doc: Product hero: a navigation bar, a headline with one phrase under a solid accent marker, two actions, social proof, and a live product window on a solid page with a faint dot grid. In the window the figures roll up, the chart draws itself and its range control changes every number; two small cards float over its edges. Everything enters in a stagger, and nothing moves under reduced motion.

components.name: HeroRelay
components.doc: Workflow hero, one full screen: the copy beside a live automation graph on a dotted canvas. Sample events arrive on their own and run the workflow node by node: a pulse in the accent travels along each line as the data moves, the branch decides which actions run, and every step reports its time. "Send test event" runs the next sample at once. The run pauses off screen, and under reduced motion each event shows its finished run without playing.

components.name: HeroCadence
components.doc: Editorial hero, one full screen: very large type with one phrase under a solid accent marker, a short paragraph beside the actions, and a strip of words that scrolls along the bottom edge. No product window and no imagery: type does the work.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `product` is centered copy over a live product window with floating cards, `workflow` sets the copy beside an automation graph that runs sample events with a pulse along each line, and `editorial` is very large type over a scrolling strip of words. The earlier names `centered`, `split` and `minimal` map to them in that order.
